claim_under_test: MECH-476 (INTERVAL axis of the A->B->A retrograde-interference falsifier)
redesign_reason: V3-EXQ-836b's non_monotone_interval_response verdict rested on a fixed 0.15 margin not scaled to observed per-arm noise (per-arm SEMs 0.098-0.147 vs deltas [+0.147,+0.213,-0.157]) and did not survive a leave-one-out check on the n400 arm's single extreme seed (failure_autopsy_v3-exq-836b_2026-07-29). This run replaces the fixed margin with a noise-scaled floor, increases n from 6 to 10 seeds per arm, reports a robust statistic (median) alongside the mean, and runs the leave-one-out check in-line so the verdict is self-auditing -- identical rule to the sibling redesigns V3-EXQ-836a (dose) and V3-EXQ-836d (novelty).
reference_build: 128-wide / 3x budget / z_world detached / credit-replay 3 / topk 32, unconstrained (no KL anchor, no distributional critic) + SD-083 offline EWC anchor
